difficulty: two-page minutes of a housing cooperative board meeting, flowing text: numbered agenda headings, an attendance list in two CSS columns next to two short lists, a budget table with a caption and a total row, a list with typed letter markers a) b) c), a boxed decision, an action-item table and signature lines
title: Minutes of the Board Meeting

headings.text: 1. Opening and approval of the agenda

key_sentences: The Chair opened the meeting at 18:35 and confirmed that a quorum was present.
The minutes of the meeting held on 21 October 2025 were approved with one correction: the roof inspection is scheduled for 4 December, not 4 November.
Spending is in line with the budget, although heating costs for the common areas are expected to rise in the last two months of the year.
The Treasurer replied that the repairs would be paid from the reserve fund if the inspection confirms the damage.
Several members felt that the cooperative’s own volunteers could look after the planting.
Hannah Brooks asked whether the bicycle shed could be lit at night.
The next meeting will be held on Tuesday 16 December 2025 in the same room.

rows: Arrange the site visit with Hollins & Daughters
Circulate the roof inspection report to the board
Request a price for lighting the bicycle shed

list_items.text: a) GreenYard Landscaping: 27,400 euros, work to start in March 2026.
b) Hollins & Daughters: 24,850 euros, work to start in April 2026.
c) Stadtgarten Services: 31,200 euros, including a five-year maintenance contract.

notes: The 'Present' list flows down two CSS columns: reading order is the first column top to bottom, then the second. The quotes list has its markers 'a)', 'b)', 'c)' typed in the text. The 'Decision:' box and the 'Vote:' line are body text. 'RIVERSIDE HOUSING COOPERATIVE' above the title is an organisation line, not a heading. The page break falls where the browser put it; if a table is split by it, it is still one table with the header once. No running header or footer.
